user.title: Choose how you want to sign in
user.description:
**Sign in using your browser (Recommended)**
Authenticate directly with Xfinity in your web browser. No Browserless account or Xfinity password storage required. Free and works with MFA.

**Automatic login using Browserless**
Use your Xfinity username, password, and Browserless API key for automated authentication. Supports automatic re-login. Requires a paid external service.

browser_callback.title: Sign in to Xfinity using your browser
browser_callback.description:
This method connects your Xfinity account without Browserless. Your username and password are entered directly on Xfinity's website and are not stored by this integration.

**Step 1 — Open the Xfinity sign-in page**

Click [Open Xfinity Sign In]({authorization_url}) to begin authentication in your web browser.

**Step 2 — Complete authentication**

Enter your Xfinity credentials and complete any verification steps requested by Xfinity.

**Step 3 — Copy the authorization callback**

When authentication succeeds, your browser will attempt to open an address beginning with:

`xfinitydigitalhome://auth?code=...&state=...`

Your browser may display an error because this address normally opens the Xfinity mobile application. This is expected.

Copy the complete callback URL if your browser displays it.

If the URL is not visible, try using a desktop browser's Developer Tools (F12) and check the Console for a message about an unrecognized `xfinitydigitalhome://` protocol.

**Step 4 — Finish connecting**

Return to Home Assistant and paste the complete callback URL into the Authorization callback URL field.

Submit the form to complete setup.

*Important: The authorization code expires and can only be used once. If setup fails or times out, restart browser authentication to obtain a new link. Do not share the callback URL or authorization code with anyone.*

browserless.title: Automatic login using Browserless
browserless.description: Home Assistant signs in through your Browserless account. The password is stored in this integration and sent to Browserless only when signing in.

data_description.address: The street address where Xfinity service is installed. It is used for outage checks.
data_description.username: Your Xfinity ID, usually the email address or username used to sign in at xfinity.com.
data_description.password: The password for that Xfinity ID. It is stored in Home Assistant and sent to Browserless only when signing in.
data_description.browserless_api_key: The API key from your Browserless account. Residential proxy units are used for each sign-in.
